flags.why: Nghịch tử is a derogatory label for a child condemned as unfilial, rather than a neutral description of disobedience.
In this well-water example, phèn refers to mineral contamination, commonly involving iron, rather than the substance alum ([reference](https://bknow.vn/nuoc-nhiem-phen/)).
flags.fix: Người ta dùng phèn để làm trong nước. = People use alum to clarify water.
